**Key takeaways:** the server is retained in ~70 production places across five areas. The dangerous set is the ~12 closure-based holders (stored `GetStore`/`ForwardRPC`/`GetMembersFunc` funcs) and the external-package interface holders — none of them name `*consul.Server`, so a lifecycle change reaches them silently. The single biggest structural trap: `Server.Shutdown` (agent/consul/server.go:1241) never touches the external gRPC server the Agent owns (agent/agent.go:875), so every gRPC service registered in server_grpc.go keeps serving from a dead server after shutdown unless the rework adds deregistration or late-binding accessors.
